claims.statement: Licensing is a contextual page-selection step within Billing & licensing; it does not establish current licenses, license rights, permissions or an actual page visit.

Payment information is a contextual page-selection step within Billing & licensing. It is not evidence of a payment method, permission to inspect sensitive billing data or a performed financial change.

The source describes choosing yearly billing in a billing-frequency prompt. This is a conditional workflow option, not a universal recommended cadence, approved expenditure or actual subscription change.

Cost-center allocation adds repositories, organizations or users for metered spending. Usage-based products such as Actions attribute through repositories or organizations; license-based products such as Copilot attribute through users. AI-credit products such as the cloud agent attribute to directly assigned users or, otherwise, the organization granting that user's Copilot license. These distinct allocation dimensions must not be collapsed; cost centers cover metered usage, not volume or subscription billing. No actual attribution or spending is observed.
The source describes navigating to Cost centers and New cost center. This is entry into a contextual creation flow, not a created cost center, known billing scope or authority to create one.
The isolated Create cost center click does not specify its identity, membership, allocation scope, prerequisites or approved financial owner; it is not a creation receipt.

The personal-account workflow links to signup, completion of the form and account creation, selection of the templated Free plan and finishing signup. This is a contextual account-creation procedure, not a mandate to create another identity or proof of current plan terms.

The fragment associates cost-center availability with the templated Enterprise product and offers an Enterprise Cloud trial CTA with marketing query parameters, new-tab HTML and an external-link icon. Trial advertising does not establish an accepted trial, current eligibility or consent to costs; no link was executed.
